description: Asked about the fall and the fool, and did not measure the bread.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Priced dinner at threepence, named the loaf, and left the cat on the book.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Compared the descent to cloth lowered, and let the hard part wait.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Told the descent, refused the fool's news, and left the chronicle open.
name: William Shakespeare
